apps.name: Sky Map

apps.limit: Phone mein compass/sensors hone chahiye.

apps.name: Wikipedia
apps.what: Wikipedia ki official app — 300+ languages mein articles, Hindi bhi. No ads, nonprofit.

apps.name: Termux
apps.what: Android pe Linux terminal — packages install karo, coding/Python seekho phone pe hi.
apps.limit: Command-line app hai — beginners ke liye thoda technical.

apps.name: Gadgetbridge
apps.what: Smartwatch/fitness band ko bina company ki cloud app ke chalao — data phone pe hi rehta hai.
apps.limit: Sirf supported devices ke saath chalta hai; Play Store pe nahi — F-Droid se.

apps.name: Jitsi Meet
apps.what: Free video meetings — account ke bina link share karo aur call shuru. Open-source.

apps.name: Auxio
apps.what: Simple, fast offline music player — apne downloaded gaane ke liye, no ads.
apps.limit: Play Store pe nahi — F-Droid se lo. Sirf phone mein saved music chalata hai.

apps.name: Feeder
apps.what: RSS feed reader — apni favourite sites/blogs ki news ek jagah, bina account ke.
apps.limit: Play Store pe nahi — F-Droid se lo.

apps.name: Thunderbird (Android)
apps.what: Thunderbird ka 100% open-source, privacy-focused email app — Android pe.
apps.priceNote: Free, open source; Play listing mein in-app purchases (donation)
apps.limit: Play Store listing pe in-app purchases dikhte hain.

apps.name: Droid-ify
apps.what: F-Droid ka fast, modern client — open-source apps dhoondo aur install karo, clean design mein.
apps.limit: Play Store pe nahi — F-Droid / GitHub se.

apps.name: NetGuard
apps.what: Bina root firewall — chuno kaunsa app internet use kare, kaunsa nahi. Data aur battery bachao.
apps.priceNote: Free, open source (GPL-3.0); Play listing mein in-app purchases
apps.limit: Kuch extra features in-app purchase se (Play listing).

apps.name: NotallyX
apps.what: Minimal notes app: rich text notes, subtasks wali task lists, reminders, labels, PIN/fingerprint lock.

apps.name: Open Camera
apps.what: Feature-rich camera app: auto-stabilise, focus modes, face detection, timer, burst mode, silent shutter.
apps.limit: Play Store listing pe "Contains ads" likha hai; F-Droid wala version lo.

apps.name: Trail Sense
apps.what: Trekking/camping toolkit bina internet: beacons pe navigation, backtrack, sunset alert, compass aur weather prediction (sensor ho to).
apps.limit: Compass ke liye compass sensor aur weather ke liye barometer chahiye. Backup tools saath rakho.

apps.name: WiFiAnalyzer
apps.what: Ghar ka WiFi slow? Ye aas-paas ke networks aur channels dikhata hai — best channel chuno.

apps.name: HeliBoard
apps.what: Privacy-friendly open-source keyboard — internet permission hi nahi, themes + layouts ke saath.
apps.limit: Play Store pe nahi — F-Droid se lo.

apps.name: Catima
apps.what: Saare loyalty cards, membership cards aur coupons ek app mein — camera se barcode scan karo, plastic cards ghar pe chhodo. No internet access, no ads.

apps.name: Binary Eye
apps.what: Fast QR + barcode scanner jo QR bhi bana sakta hai. No ads, open-source.

apps.name: Fossify File Manager
apps.what: Fast, ad-free file manager: search, compress, favourite folders, hidden files pe password/fingerprint lock. Internet access hi nahi.

apps.name: Fossify Calendar
apps.what: Clean, ad-free calendar: events, reminders, repeat rules, widgets. Google Calendar/Outlook ke saath sync bhi.

apps.name: Tasks.org
apps.what: To-do list jo offline chale: nested subtasks, repeating tasks, tags, reminders. Google Tasks sync optional.
apps.priceNote: Free, open source (GPL-3.0); Play listing mein in-app purchases
apps.limit: Play Store listing pe in-app purchases hain (kuch extra features paid).

apps.name: VLC
apps.what: Lagbhag har video aur audio format chala deta hai — phone ki files bhi, network streams bhi. Fast, no ads.

apps.name: Image Toolbox
apps.what: Photo ka swiss knife: resize, crop, compress, format convert, filters, OCR (text nikalna), background remove, EXIF edit, PDF banana.
apps.limit: Features bahut saare hain, shuru me thoda explore karna padega.

apps.name: ColorBlendr
apps.what: Android 12+ pe Material You / system accent colors customize: wallpaper ya apna seed color, saturation/lightness sliders, presets, pitch black.
apps.limit: Android 12+ (Material You ROM) + Root, Shizuku ya Wireless ADB mode chahiye; Root pe full features, Shizuku/ADB pe kam. Play Store pe nahi.

apps.name: URLCheck
apps.what: Link kholne se pehle beech me khulta hai: redirects/short links check, URL details, trackers hatana, suspicious/phishing links pe warning (VirusTotal, hosts list).
apps.limit: VirusTotal scan ke liye free VirusTotal account ki personal API key lagti hai; Unshortener online service (unshorten.me) use karta hai, private links mat bhejo.

apps.name: HTTP Shortcuts
apps.what: Custom HTTP requests (APIs, webhooks, smart home, automation) ko home screen shortcut bana do; ek tap me request chalti hai. Scripting + variables bhi.
apps.limit: Thoda technical: API/URL ki basic samajh chahiye.

apps.name: OpenScan
apps.what: Privacy wala document scanner: documents/notes/cards scan, live edge detection se auto crop, filters, PDF/JPG export. No ads.
apps.limit: OCR (text nikalna) official repo me listed nahi; sirf Android.

apps.name: LanguageTool
apps.what: Assignment, email, resume ki English grammar + spelling galtiyan pakdo. Chrome, Word, Google Docs mein chalta hai.
apps.limit: Free mein ek baar mein 2,000 characters, AI rephrase sirf 3/day.

apps.name: Khan Academy
apps.what: Class 1-12 Maths, Science aur aur subjects: videos, practice, tests. NCERT/CBSE aligned, Hindi mein bhi. Nonprofit.
apps.limit: Live teacher / personal doubt-solving nahi.

apps.name: NPTEL
apps.what: IIT aur IISc ke courses — padhai bilkul free, koi bhi join kar sakta hai.
apps.limit: Certificate ke liye proctored exam dena hota hai, woh paid hai.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.what: Unlimited notes, bina sign-up, offline. Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux sab pe.
apps.limit: Devices ke beech auto-sync paid hai (Sync $4/month, yearly billing).

apps.name: Zotero
apps.what: Research papers, PDFs save karo, ek click mein citation/bibliography. Project aur thesis ke liye best. Open-source, nonprofit.
apps.limit: Free cloud storage sirf 300 MB (2 GB = $20/year).

apps.name: AnySoftKeyboard
apps.what: Open-source keyboard: layouts, themes, gesture typing — sab apni marzi ka.

apps.name: Quillpad
apps.what: Markdown notes, task lists, notebooks, tags, reminders — no ads.

apps.name: APKUpdater
apps.what: Installed apps ke updates kai sources (F-Droid, GitHub, Play, APKMirror...) se ek jagah check karta hai, background notification ke saath.
apps.limit: F-Droid pe nahi — GitHub releases se lo. Update sirf trusted source ka install karo.

apps.name: GKD
apps.what: Accessibility + custom rules se repetitive screen taps automate karo (advanced users ke liye).
apps.limit: Accessibility permission chahiye; rules default nahi aate, khud add karne padte hain. UI zyada-tar Chinese.

apps.name: SD Maid SE
apps.what: Storage analyse karo, cache aur uninstalled apps ki leftover files clean karo, duplicates dhoondo.
apps.limit: Delete se pehle list check karo. Kuch extra features optional Pro upgrade mein.

apps.name: Rethink: DNS + Firewall + VPN
apps.what: Apps ki network activity dikhata hai, per-app firewall (internet block), DNS blocklists se ads/trackers block.
apps.priceNote: Free, open source (Play listing me in-app purchases)
apps.limit: Android ke VPN slot me chalta hai, to saath me dusra VPN ek time pe nahi chalega.

apps.name: App Manager
apps.what: Apps ki activities, permissions, signatures dekho; apps me trackers/libraries scan karo.
apps.limit: Power-user app. Dekhna bina root chalta hai, par permissions revoke/components block jaise changes Root/ADB maangte hain. Play Store pe nahi.

apps.name: Kvaesitso Launcher
apps.what: Search-focused launcher: apps, contacts, calendar, Wikipedia ek search me; calculator + unit converter.
apps.limit: Pixel + Android 11+ pe best (README). F-Droid build me kuch non-free API features removed; full build developer ke repo/IzzyOnDroid se.

apps.name: Arcticons
apps.what: 15,000+ line-style icons — minimal, clutter-free home screen.
apps.limit: Icon pack hai, app nahi: icon-pack support wala launcher chahiye.

apps.name: Discreet Launcher
apps.what: Distraction-free home screen, apps rename/hide, offline, no ads, icon packs support.
apps.limit: ⚠️ Project ARCHIVED hai (ab updates/fixes nahi aayenge). F-Droid se install hota hai.

apps.name: Spliit
apps.what: Trip, hostel, flat ka kharcha split karo — no ads, no account, open-source (Splitwise Pro ka free jawab).
apps.limit: Login nahi hai, group link sirf apno ko bhejo. Android pe website se chalao (Android app nahi).

apps.name: Wormhole
apps.what: 10 GB tak file bhejo bina signup, end-to-end encrypted (WeTransfer ka free jawab).
apps.limit: Link 24 ghante me expire. 5 GB se badi file pe bhejne wale ka page khula rehna chahiye.

apps.name: Proton VPN Free
apps.what: Free VPN: no ads, no logs, data/speed ki koi limit nahi (NordVPN ka free jawab).
apps.limit: Free me sirf 1 device. Streaming unlock aur top speed sirf paid Plus me.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.what: Password manager: unlimited passwords, unlimited devices, open-source (1Password ka free jawab).
apps.limit: Built-in 2FA codes aur file attachments Premium me.

apps.name: Medito
apps.what: Meditation, sleep stories, breathing — sab free, non-profit, no ads (Headspace/Calm ka free jawab).
apps.limit: Abhi sirf English me (kuch Spanish sessions).

apps.name: AntennaPod
apps.what: Open-source podcast player: subscribe, download, offline suno — free, no ads.

apps.name: Obtainium
apps.what: Apps ke updates seedha developer ke source (GitHub, F-Droid etc.) se — store ke bina.
apps.limit: Sirf official source URL add karo; signature warning aaye to ruk jao.

apps.name: Breezy Weather
apps.what: Open-source weather app: clean design, forecasts, widgets, no ads.

apps.name: Markor
apps.what: Plain-text / Markdown notes + to-do list, offline, open-source.
apps.limit: Sync/backup khud nahi hota — important notes ki alag backup rakho.

apps.name: Mika
apps.what: Phone ka AI agent: bolo kya chahiye, ye apps kholta hai, buttons dabata hai, websites browse karke task poora karta hai (hidden background screen pe).
apps.priceNote: Free, open source (Apache-2.0); AI model ka cost apna
apps.limit: Apni AI model API key ya ChatGPT/xAI/OpenRouter account lagega. Apps chalane ke liye Android 12+ (chat ke liye 11+), ek baar wireless-debugging pairing. Login, OTP, payment tumhe khud karne padte hai.
